claim: NextReg 0x34 and port 0x303B/0x57 use separate sprite selectors; a model that aliases them approves builds that show stale copies or echoes.

evidence.text: A simulator that aliases them falsely approves stale copies; explicit port selection and a broken-selector negative now cover it.
hooklib.NextModel let NextReg 0x34 set the attribute port's sprite (real machine only with lockstep on): a build relying on it passed every check and showed echoes; sprite 0 now chosen via 0x303B.
